scope: Independent source and pure accounting review only; no actual MiniWoB result was reviewed in this record.
conclusion: No additional concrete accounting defect found in the frozen source after the bounded-inventory, outcome, counter, duration and returned-call joins were added. Actual receipt validation and rendered-chart inspection remain separate.
checked: The frozen denominator is 24 cases per variant, including missing cases labelled unknown rather than recorded failures.
Only scale 1.0 versus frozen 0.5 is accepted, with exact task/seed inventory and no duplicate completed cases.
Native terminal binary reward joins the success boolean; numeric counters and times reject bools, nonfinite or negative values.
Completed episode model-call counts join unique returned generation records; entered but unreturned calls are not invented as latency observations.
Returned scored requests from a partial final episode remain in the request metric and are explicitly labelled. Neutral warmups are excluded.
Gains and regressions use only common completed cases; missing cases are not called paired regressions.
The chart calls full request latency a returned model request metric, not isolated decoding throughput. It includes child status, partial-return scope, and no Astra/population/billing claim.

pure_checks.mechanism: AST-extracted unchanged summarize function and constants with standard-library imports; in-memory synthetic accounting fixture only. No model, provider, browser, chart or invented result file.
pure_checks.positive_case: Two complete pairs with one gain and one regression; two high-latency warmups excluded; one edited partial-episode return included; one entered/unreturned call preserved only in entered count; fixed 24 denominator and 22 missing per variant.

limits: This source review does not prove the runtime receipt is authentic or complete.
No chart was rendered during this review; actual rendered layout still requires inspection.
